title: Last Stone Weight
statement: Take the two heaviest stones. If their weights match, discard both. Otherwise return their positive weight difference to the collection. Continue while at least two stones remain. Return the weight of the final stone, or zero if there is none.

examples.explanation: The stones have the same weight and both vanish.
There is no second stone to remove.

hints: Conceptual: Each round needs the two heaviest current stones.
Directional: Use a max-priority queue to remove the largest weight twice.
Implementation: Insert the difference only when it is positive. Stop when the queue has fewer than two elements.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log(n+1)) time and O(n) space with a heap.
